name_en: Tracy-Widom distribution: random matrices and KPZ
category: mathematical physics / random matrices and stochastic PDE
canonical_claim: The beta-2 Tracy-Widom distribution F_2, concretely identified by the Airy-kernel Fredholm determinant, is both the distributional limit of the centered and N^(2/3)-scaled largest eigenvalue of normalized N by N GUE matrices and the distributional limit of the centered and T^(1/3)-scaled height at the origin for the narrow-wedge KPZ equation as T tends to infinity, with all constants fixed from the selected primary sources.

canonical_formal_target.environment_fingerprint: pending statement phase; repository pins Lean 4 v4.29.0 and mathlib revision 8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95

domain_and_universes: finite complex Hermitian random matrices, real-valued random variables and probability laws, the narrow-wedge KPZ solution, and an analytic realization of F_2; exact Lean universes open
quantifiers: matrix size N tending to infinity, KPZ time T tending to infinity, and every real distribution threshold s; exact binder order open
hypotheses: the source-normalized GUE law; a source-specified narrow-wedge solution concept for KPZ driven by space-time white noise; measurability and analytic existence assumptions must be exposed rather than assumed as the conclusion
conclusion: both normalized fluctuations converge in distribution to the same concretely constructed beta-2 Tracy-Widom law
excluded_degenerate_cases: N = 0, T <= 0, non-Hermitian matrices, non-narrow-wedge KPZ initial data, and changed scalings without a checked transport
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical and choice requirements for spectral, measure, operator, and SPDE theory not yet frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository-pinned toolchain, and pinned mathlib; exact imports and transitive declaration closure open
computation_profile: analytic and probabilistic theorem; numerical simulation, finite-size histograms, and numerical PDE solutions cannot substitute for either limit
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate intake-derived statement work if a selected primary source, normalization, KPZ solution concept, toolchain, mathlib pin, canonical claim, or exclusion changes.
status_boundary: A planned intake only: no exact Lean expression, H0, M0, R0, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
